# Third-party asset sources

## Modular Industrial Pipes 01

**Creator:** Jorge Camacho. **Source:** [Poly Haven — Modular Industrial Pipes 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/modular_industrial_pipes_01). **License:** CC0, confirmed on the asset page and [Poly Haven’s license page](https://polyhaven.com/license). CC0 does not require attribution; the creator and source are recorded here for provenance. Retrieved on 2026-10-10.

The project includes the 1K glTF variant with its JPG PBR maps for mobile-size use. Poly Haven describes the full asset as 2 m tall and 12K triangles; the game scales it to 75% and mounts the assembly in the second service bay. The eight imported files total **4,823,938 bytes** (about 4.60 MiB): one glTF, one binary mesh buffer, and six referenced 1K textures.

The files are under `assets/third_party/polyhaven/modular_industrial_pipes_01/`. They were downloaded from URLs in Poly Haven’s official files API, and each file’s byte count and MD5 matched the API metadata at retrieval. The source files are unmodified; scale, position, rotation, and a simplified collision proxy are configured by the game script.

## Concrete Wall 003

**Creators:** Dimitrios Savva (photography) and Rico Cilliers (processing). **Source:** [Poly Haven — Concrete Wall 003](https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_wall_003). **License:** CC0, confirmed on the asset page and [Poly Haven’s license page](https://polyhaven.com/license). Poly Haven states that CC0 permits any purpose, including commercial use, and does not require attribution; the creators and source are recorded here for provenance. Retrieved on 2026-10-12.

The project includes only four 1K JPG maps under `assets/third_party/polyhaven/concrete_wall_003_1k/textures/`: diffuse (264,756 bytes), OpenGL normal (228,062 bytes), roughness (258,206 bytes), and ambient occlusion (120,058 bytes). Total: **871,082 bytes** (about 0.83 MiB). Each file’s byte count and MD5 matched Poly Haven’s official files API at retrieval. The original texture files are unmodified; the game uses them on only the second service bay’s back wall as a contained visual trial. The remaining walls keep the procedural concrete material for comparison. Displacement is intentionally omitted for this mobile-focused trial.
